title: Connector link error frame
description: The one generic refusal frame (C-05.10). Channel-specific answers (relay.ws.refused, a contract 07 queue.ack outcome, a contract 06 status reason) are used where they exist.

error.description: A frame the receiver could not act on (C-05.10). With `fatal` the sender closes with 4400 next. Direction: both directions.

ch.description: The channel this frame travels on (C-05.10).

kind.description: The frame kind within its channel.

id.description: This frame's id, unique per sender per connection. A reply names it in `re`.

seq.description: Per connection, per channel, per direction: 1 for the first frame, plus 1 for each next (C-05.11). Durable positions live in the bodies (contract 07 cursors, hub_msg_id, contract 06 rev), never here.

at.description: When the sender built the frame. Informative; never used for ordering or expiry.

re.description: The `id` of the frame this one answers.

fatal.description: True when the link closes next.

hint.description: Hub to connector only: in words. A connector's error carries the code and ids only (contract 11, C-11.6).
